scope.summary: Implement export mesh topology options across all mesh lanes (CG-25, MD Weld/Unweld + Merge Vertex by Proximity + Thin/Thick + Add Pattern Thickness; GREQ-020): weld/unweld sewn vertices, distance-based merge-by-proximity, thin vs thick export (pattern thickness extrusion with curved side profile and front/back/seam face toggles), and triangle-vs-quad output per target profile, per Section 13.12 §6.
acceptance_criteria: ExportTopologyOptions (weld_sewn: bool, merge_proximity_mm: Option<f32>, thickness: Thin|Thick{profile}, face_output: front/back/side toggles, primitive: Tri|Quad) accepted by OBJ/glTF/USD/Alembic-shim/MDD-PC2 lanes and stored on ExportPresets (MT-435/448).
Thick export extrudes per-pattern thickness with curved side geometry profile (curvature %) and correct side UVs (back/side UV expansion per MD 2025.0 parity note recorded).
Weld keeps UV seams intact via split-UV weld strategy; merge-by-proximity welds within tolerance without collapsing intentional gaps (validation guard).
Quad output preserved where source is quad (MT-385) and triangulated only for Tri-target profiles (UE Chaos prefers tris - GREQ-020).
scope.risk_if_missed: DCC pipelines break on the wrong topology contract (double vertices, missing thickness, forced triangulation); MD users switch these per destination on every export.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
